# CodePipelineProcessPayloadsResponse

Tool calls and transcript entries of a code pipeline run. To read a step's transcript in order, merge its entries from the two lists by `sequence`. Fetched for one step, each list is in `sequence` order; fetched by id, they may span steps and are not sorted.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `toolUses` | [`CodePipelineProcessToolUse`](code-pipeline-process-tool-use.md)`[]` | The tool calls. Never null. |
| `contextEntries` | [`CodePipelineProcessContextEntry`](code-pipeline-process-context-entry.md)`[]` | The transcript entries (the agents' text and thinking). Never null. |
